'''''I Come In Peace''''' was one of the [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] gunships used to bring wounded [[Clone trooper/Legends|clones]] away from the destroyed [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] [[Geonosis primary droid foundry/Legends|primary droid foundry]] [[Geonosis ray shield generator/Legends|Ray Shield Fortress]] during the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]].<ref name="LaPR" />
